hunks.baseline: At the end of countless gazes, a wave of calamity poured over the distant, winding hills of the plateau, blackening them beneath its tide.
hunks.sol: Beyond countless stunned gazes, a wave of calamity poured over the winding hills of the distant plateau, blackening them as it came.

hunks.baseline: A deep rumble, as if rising from the depths of an abyss.
hunks.sol: A rumble seemed to rise from the depths of an abyss.

hunks.baseline: The vast shadow everyone had believed to be a mountain roared—the countless monsters crouched within it.
hunks.sol: The vast shadow everyone had believed to be a mountain roared—the countless monsters crouched within it roaring as one.

hunks.baseline: The earth shook. Torrential rain burst from the sky. They planted a chill in their enemies even deeper than the cold air of the plateau that touched the heavens.
hunks.sol: They shook the earth and scattered the driving rain, sending a chill through their enemies deeper than the cold air of the plateau that touched the heavens.

hunks.baseline: Frozen in place, people stared at the unbelievable sight.
hunks.sol: People stood frozen, staring at the impossible sight.

hunks.baseline: Anyone who’d glimpsed the enemy in that flash of lightning couldn’t help but think of the gods.
hunks.sol: Anyone who’d glimpsed the enemy in that flash of lightning couldn’t help but think of a god.

hunks.baseline: They didn’t know the exact name or form of that mighty being who must exist somewhere among the clouds and stars. What did such a trivial detail matter?
hunks.sol: They might not know the name or form of that mighty being somewhere among the clouds and stars, but what did such trivial details matter?

hunks.baseline: The moment you long for light most desperately is when you’re trapped in pitch darkness.
hunks.sol: You long for light most desperately when you’re trapped in pitch darkness.

hunks.baseline: The answers to every question he’d asked came rushing toward them, hundreds of zhang away, so clear and horrifying that they became reality.
hunks.sol: The answers to all his questions were rushing toward him from hundreds of zhang away, horrifyingly clear.

hunks.baseline: The meaning in the quiet call was clear. Song Ho, the Thousand-Faced Fox, nodded and hurled a small cylinder with all his might. No one knew when he’d taken it from inside his robes.
hunks.sol: The meaning in the quiet call was clear. Song Ho, the Thousand-Faced Fox, nodded and hurled a small cylinder with all his might. Jin Wikyung hadn’t even seen him take it from his robes.

hunks.baseline: Through the sparks drifting slowly down and painting the sky, the hideous monsters appeared once more.
hunks.sol: Through the sparks drifting slowly down across the sky, the hideous monsters appeared once more.

hunks.baseline: Yet the light was bright enough to reach the rear of the army, more than ten li away, and the fierce blast briefly washed away the people’s fear.
hunks.sol: Yet the light was bright enough to be seen from the rear of the army, more than ten li away, and the fierce blast briefly washed away the people’s fear.

hunks.baseline: Even the tightest net loosens as time goes by.
hunks.sol: Even the tightest net loosens over time.

hunks.baseline: The Murim allied forces had set out with enough momentum to bring down Tianshan in a single stroke. But after a month of nonstop advance with no chance to catch their breath, the people were already exhausted. The barren land and lack of food had pushed them to their limits.
hunks.sol: The Murim allied forces had set out with enough momentum to bring down Tianshan in a single stroke. But after a month of nonstop advance with no chance to catch their breath, they were already exhausted. The barren land and lack of food had pushed them to their limits.

hunks.baseline: Their fatigue had naturally piled up, and their march—once as steady as an unobstructed river—had begun to falter.
hunks.sol: Their fatigue had piled up, and their march—once as steady as an unobstructed river—had begun to falter.

hunks.baseline: It was a terrible stroke of misfortune that this happened when the Jin Family of Taiyuan, one of the weaker forces in the alliance, had taken the vanguard for a short time. But the fact that Jin Wikyung was leading them was one small piece of good fortune amid the bad.
hunks.sol: It was terrible luck that this happened while the Jin Family of Taiyuan, one of the weaker forces in the alliance, was briefly holding the vanguard. But they were fortunate in one respect: Jin Wikyung was leading them.

hunks.baseline: Though his martial arts weren’t on the same level as his two younger brothers’, he was a leader everyone acknowledged.
hunks.sol: His martial arts might not match those of his two younger brothers, but everyone acknowledged him as a leader.

hunks.baseline: His shout, infused with Peak internal energy, shook the plateau. His blazing eyes poured fire.
hunks.sol: His shout, infused with Peak internal energy, shook the plateau. His eyes blazed like torches.

hunks.baseline: The people who’d instinctively started to retreat stopped in their tracks.
hunks.sol: Those who’d instinctively begun to retreat stopped in their tracks.

hunks.baseline: But that alone wouldn’t overcome all the fear gripping them. Facing the gazes turned toward him, Jin Wikyung shouted again.
hunks.sol: But that alone couldn’t overcome the fear gripping them. Jin Wikyung met the eyes turned toward him and shouted again.

hunks.baseline: The halted feet began moving forward again. Trembling fingers closed around sword hilts.
hunks.sol: Feet that had stopped began moving forward again. Trembling fingers closed around sword hilts.

hunks.baseline: The ground trembled harder. Jin Wikyung’s voice rang out with rising force.
hunks.sol: The ground trembled harder. Jin Wikyung’s voice rose above it.

hunks.baseline: The frightened horses snorted fiercely. Faces muddled by exhaustion of body and mind came into view.
hunks.sol: The frightened horses snorted fiercely. He could see faces clouded by exhaustion of body and mind.

hunks.baseline: “Face them with your heads held high! If you can’t cast off your fear, then cut it down along with the enemy!”
hunks.sol: “Face them with your heads held high! If you can’t cast off your fear, cut it down along with the enemy!”

hunks.baseline: As if breaking chains that had bound their wrists, they drew their weapons.
hunks.sol: As if breaking chains around their wrists, they drew their weapons.

hunks.baseline: Together, they pointed them toward the wave of monsters, now less than a hundred zhang away.
hunks.sol: Together, they aimed them at the wave of monsters, now only a hundred zhang away.

hunks.baseline: Their breath came fast, white puffs spilling from their mouths.
hunks.sol: Their breathing quickened, white puffs spilling from their mouths.

hunks.baseline: Their mouths felt gritty, as if they’d chewed a handful of sand. Their hearts hammered as though they might burst at any moment.
hunks.sol: Their mouths felt gritty, as though they’d chewed a handful of sand. Their hearts hammered as if they might burst.

hunks.baseline: But now, not a single person retreated.
hunks.sol: But no one retreated now.

hunks.baseline: Even as the horses that couldn’t overcome their fear broke free of their masters and bolted in every direction.
hunks.sol: Not when horses broke free of their masters and bolted in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Even as the hundred zhang between them shrank by half, then half again.
hunks.sol: Not when the hundred zhang between them shrank by half, then half again.

hunks.baseline: Even when a giant monster, its height level with the pavilions of a great city, uprooted a massive boulder that had lain deep in the plateau and hurled it at them.
hunks.sol: Not even when a giant monster, its height level with the pavilions of a great city, tore a massive boulder from where it lay embedded in the plateau and hurled it at them.

hunks.baseline: No—in truth, a great boulder high in the air had blocked the rain falling over their heads.
hunks.sol: No—the great boulder overhead had blocked the rain falling on them.

hunks.baseline: As someone let out a cry, Jin Wikyung’s tightly closed lips parted.
hunks.sol: Someone cried out. Jin Wikyung’s tightly closed lips parted.

hunks.baseline: “Little brother.”
hunks.sol: “Second brother.”

hunks.baseline: Raindrops, wind, air—
Even a boulder weighing a thousand geun, holding centuries of history, was cut through in an instant without a sound.
hunks.sol: Sharp enough to cut through raindrops, wind, and air—and even a thousand-geun boulder that had lain there for centuries—in a single silent stroke.

hunks.baseline: A flash like lightning blazed—and that was all.
hunks.sol: A flash like lightning blazed, and it was over.

hunks.baseline: The blue wave that overflowed from one man’s sword split the enormous boulder—not a bird—into dozens of pieces and sent them tumbling down the hill.
hunks.sol: The blue wave surging from one man’s sword split the enormous boulder—not a bird—into dozens of pieces and sent them tumbling down the hill.

hunks.baseline: Through the torrential rain, too heavy for even a cloud of dust to rise, the young Sword Demon of the Jin Family of Taiyuan had finally shaken off the monsters’ pursuit and returned. He muttered under his breath,
hunks.sol: Through rain so heavy that not even a cloud of dust could rise, the young Sword Demon of the Jin Family of Taiyuan returned, having finally shaken off the monsters pursuing him. He muttered under his breath.

hunks.baseline: With a small sigh at his older brother’s tone, Jin Mukyung accepted the hat.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung sighed softly at his older brother’s tone and accepted the hat.

hunks.baseline: He tied the chin strap of the oil-treated bamboo hat tight. The fierce raindrops no longer obscured his vision.
hunks.sol: Once he’d tied the oil-treated bamboo hat’s chin strap tight, the driving rain no longer obscured his vision.

hunks.baseline: The monsters’ momentum hadn’t diminished. Staring at the countless creatures charging ahead without hesitation, Jin Mukyung tightened his grip on his sword hilt.
hunks.sol: The monsters showed no sign of slowing. Jin Mukyung stared at the countless creatures charging toward him and tightened his grip on his sword hilt.

hunks.baseline: He simply had a reason to fight—and believed in that reason. That was why he didn’t waver.
hunks.sol: He simply had a reason to fight, and faith in that reason. That was why he didn’t waver.

hunks.baseline: *That’s right. I believe in him. And so does everyone else.*
hunks.sol: *That’s right. I believe in him. We all do.*

hunks.baseline: He wasn’t here, but that was a good thing.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t here, and that was a relief.

hunks.baseline: The more monsters filled the view before them, the smaller the threat to Jin Taekyung would be.
hunks.sol: The more monsters they faced here, the fewer would threaten Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung took a deep breath, stepped out of the tightly formed defensive formation, and walked forward.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung took a deep breath and stepped out of the tightly formed defensive formation.

hunks.baseline: That single step was the last distance between humans and monsters.
hunks.sol: That single step closed the last distance between humans and monsters.

hunks.baseline: A monster’s enormous fist plunged down with a fierce burst of air. Its horrible stench seeped deep into his nose, but he didn’t care.
hunks.sol: A monster’s enormous fist plunged down with a fierce rush of air. Its horrible stench filled Jin Mukyung’s nose, but he didn’t care.

hunks.baseline: It silently carved apart the fist bearing down on them, swallowing the monsters at the front whole.
hunks.sol: It silently carved apart the fist bearing down on him and swallowed the monsters at the front whole.

hunks.baseline: The stench rising from their rotting bodies wasn’t as foul as the one Jin Mukyung had smelled before. And a new light was layered over the blue Sword Force that blazed through the surroundings, illuminating and tearing through everything in its path.
hunks.sol: The stench rising from their rotting bodies wasn’t as foul as the one Jin Mukyung had smelled before. And a new light was settling over the blue Sword Force that lit up the surroundings as it slashed through everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: Like the sunset, gently coloring the world as the sun slowly sank.
hunks.sol: Like the sunset gently coloring the world as the sun slowly sank.

hunks.baseline: Or like a flower petal surrendering itself to a breeze from nowhere.
hunks.sol: Or a flower petal drifting on a breeze from nowhere.

hunks.baseline: With a cry echoing in his heart, Jin Mukyung understood what this strange yet warm power was.
hunks.sol: As the realization sounded within him, Jin Mukyung understood what this strange yet warm power was.

hunks.baseline: He also understood who had given rise to that purple Force, which had slipped quietly onto the battlefield like a passing breeze.
hunks.sol: He knew, too, whose purple Force had slipped quietly onto the battlefield like a passing breeze.

hunks.baseline: No one had noticed exactly when he appeared, or how he’d moved.
hunks.sol: No one had noticed exactly when he appeared or how he’d moved.

hunks.baseline: All that remained was the rich scent of plum blossoms, lingering at the tip of his nose and erasing even the monsters’ stench.
hunks.sol: Only the rich scent of plum blossoms lingered, erasing even the monsters’ stench.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Saint, Mae Jonghak, spoke, his eyes sinking deep.
hunks.sol: The Sword Saint, Mae Jonghak, spoke, his gaze deep and still.

hunks.baseline: Above the purple plum blossoms that finally bloomed and scattered, the leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang and the heads of the Five Great Families plunged down like meteors, led by four of the Ten Kings.
hunks.sol: Above the purple plum blossoms that finally bloomed and scattered, the Sect Leaders of the Nine Sects and One Gang and the heads of the Five Great Families plunged down like meteors, led by four of the Ten Kings.
